title: Jamaican Veggie Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy Jamaican-inspired wrap filled with roasted vegetables and served in a crispy bread bowl.
instructions: Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
In a large bowl, toss together the chopped carrots, sliced red bell peppers, sliced yellow onions, and sliced zucchini.
Add the chopped cilantro, Scotch Bonnet peppers (if using), and Jamaican Jerk Seasoning to the bowl and toss to combine.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to the toasted bread slices and top with a dollop of your favorite spread or hummus.
Serve the Jamaican Veggie Wrap in a crispy bread bowl and enjoy!
Note: If using Scotch Bonnet peppers, be sure to wear gloves when handling to avoid skin irritation.
